name: runtime-evolution-workbench
description: Capture Codex Runs locally and turn failures and corrections into evidence-backed AGENTS.md or Skill experiments.

interface.shortDescription: Save, diagnose, compare, and safely evolve Codex Runs.
interface.longDescription: Adds local lifecycle capture, evidence tools, and a bounded evolution workflow. Ordinary Runs remain usable when the workbench is closed; changes are always reviewable and require human approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Runtime Evolution Workbench evidence to inspect this Codex Run. State observation gaps before proposing any AGENTS.md or Skill change.
